title: cyclotrichium origanifolium
intro: Cyclotrichium origanifolium, commonly known as Mountain Mint, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, offering benefits such as digestive aid, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in alleviating symptoms of nausea, indigestion, and muscle spasms. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Mint include its ability to relax muscles, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
